transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’m here because I’m having trouble keeping my mind on things. At work I’ll look at a loan worksheet or a follow-up list and keep reading the same line, over and over. Then I end up putting off calls because even simple decisions feel harder than they should.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Yeah… most days, I guess. It’s not always crying or anything. More like this heavy, dull feeling that just kind of sits there. Even when I’m doing things I used to enjoy, like being at the community center or out in the garden, I feel like I’m just… going through the motions. Keeping a smile on because that’s what you do.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, dull feeling?
It’s been… a little over two years now. It started after a close friend of mine died.
Have you experienced any periods where your sadness was significantly worse than it is now?
I’m not sure. It’s sort of been steady… maybe some days feel heavier than others, but I don’t know that there was a separate period that was much worse.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, or has that changed?

It’s changed, I think. I still go to the community center, and I still work in the garden… but it doesn’t really lift me up like it used to. Most days there’s just this dull heaviness, and I’m kind of going through the motions, smiling because I’m supposed to.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing?

Not really like before. I still go to the community center, and I work in the garden sometimes… but most days that heaviness is still there. I feel like I’m just doing it because I should, smiling along, not really enjoying it.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your appetite or sleep patterns recently?
I don’t think there’s been anything significant recently. My sleep and appetite… I guess they’re about the same as usual. I haven’t really noticed a big change.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing, even if it's just a little bit?

Maybe a little, sometimes. I still go to the community center, and I’ll spend time in the garden… those used to help more. Now it’s mostly just this dull heaviness, and I kind of smile and keep doing what I’m supposed to do.
Would you say that this heavy, dull feeling you've been experiencing is mild, moderate, or severe?

I’d say… moderate, I guess. It’s there most days, that dull heaviness, even when I’m at the community center or in the garden. I can still show up and smile, but it feels like I’m just going through the motions.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy, but now find you no longer take pleasure in?

Yeah… I guess the community center and my garden. I still do them, but they don’t really lift me up like they used to. Most days it’s just this dull heaviness, and I’m sort of… going through the motions, smiling because that’s what you do.
Do you ever have days where you feel a little better and can enjoy things, even if it's just for a short time?
Sometimes, maybe a little. But most days that heaviness is still there. Even if I’m at the community center or in the garden, I’m mostly just… going through it, smiling along.
Do you ever have days where you feel noticeably worse than others?

Yeah… some days feel heavier than others. Most days there’s already this dull weight there, but on the worse days even being at the community center or out in the garden doesn’t really touch it. I just sort of get through it and keep a smile on.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing?

Not really like before. I still go to the community center, and I still work in my garden… but most days there’s this heaviness there. I’m doing it, smiling and all, but it feels more like going through the motions.
Have you had any distinct periods where your symptoms were noticeably worse than they are now?
I’m not really sure. I mean, some days are worse than others, but I don’t know that I’d call it a separate period or anything. It’s mostly just been… kind of steady.
Have you had any two-week period or longer in the past two years where you didn't feel this heavy, dull feeling?

No… I don’t think so. It’s been there most days, that dull heaviness. Even when I’m at the center or out in the garden, I’m usually just kind of… doing it, smiling, but not really feeling lifted by it.
Have you had any two-week period in the last two years where you felt mostly back to your normal self, without this heavy, dull feeling?

No… not really. It’s pretty much been there most days, that dull heaviness. Even when I’m at the community center or in the garden, I’m mostly just… getting through it, I guess. Smiling, but not feeling like myself.
Have you had any two-week period or longer in the past two years where you didn't experience any of these depressive feelings?

No… I don’t think there’s been two weeks like that. Most days that heaviness is still there, even when I’m doing things I used to enjoy, like the community center or my garden. I’m there, but it feels like I’m just going through the motions.
Have you had any two-week period in the last two years where you felt completely free of these depressive feelings?
No… I don’t think so. Most days that dull heaviness is still there. Even when I’m at the center or in my garden, I’m kind of just… doing it, smiling, but not really feeling free of it.
Have you had any two-week period or longer in the past two years where you didn't experience this heavy, dull feeling at all?
No… I don’t think so. It’s been there most days, that dull heaviness. Even when I’m at the community center or in my garden, I’m still kind of just going through the motions.
Have you had any two-week period in the last two years where you felt completely back to your normal self?
No… not really. Since my close friend died, a little over two years ago, I don’t think I’ve felt fully like myself again.
